title: 部门人力成本与加班
context: 财务与人资联合分析部门第四季度人工成本。
requirements: 按员工月薪归属岗位；基础薪资+奖金+估算加班费（每月176小时、1.5倍基础时薪，按分钟；逐员工月四舍五入到分）；统计部门×月成本、工时与加班，成本每出勤小时。
commonError: 连接每日考勤后直接求月薪会重复累计；估算工资不代表实际法定工资。
executionSteps: 从员工月成本视图核对计算规则
mysqlSql: SELECT department_id,month_key,SUM(base_cents) base_cents,SUM(bonus_cents) bonus_cents,SUM(overtime_minutes) overtime_minutes,SUM(labor_cents) labor_cents,ROUND(60.0*SUM(labor_cents)/NULLIF(SUM(worked_minutes+overtime_minutes),0),2) cost_per_hour_cents FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-10' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,month_key ORDER BY department_id,month_key
